events.text: Telekids first aired on RTL 4 at 6:25pm.

evidence.quote: showing on the RTL 4 channel from 1989 to 1999
The show first aired on October 2 , 1989 at 6:25pm

events.text: Anniko van Santen began presenting Telekids weekday broadcasts.

evidence.quote: presenter Anniko van Santen started presenting the weekday broadcasts of Telekids from 1992
The 1000th broadcast of the program was broadcast in April 1992

events.text: Carlo Boszhard joined Telekids as co-presenter.
Telekids began live Saturday morning broadcasts, 7am to noon.

evidence.quote: From then on , Telekids was broadcast live every Saturday morning between 7am and 12 noon

events.text: Boszhard returned to Telekids, replacing Irene Moors.

evidence.quote: In the spring of 1993 Boszhard returned again , because he replaced Moors

events.text: A Telekids CD (hit Pittige Tijden) was released.

evidence.quote: a reissue of the Telekids CD from 1995

events.text: Cartoons moved into a block before 9 a.m.; studio slot followed.

evidence.quote: From September 1996 , the cartoons were mainly placed in a block until 9 a.m.

events.label: award
events.text: Carlo & Irene duo received gold record for Telekids CD reissue.

evidence.quote: The duo Carlo & Irene received a gold record in 1997

events.text: Telekids went off the air; RTL 4 run ended.

evidence.quote: showing on the RTL 4 channel from 1989 to 1999
The program was off the air between 1999 and 2010

events.text: RTL announced Telekids would return on RTL 8.

evidence.quote: On August 19 , 2010 it was announced that Telekids would return to television
On August 19 , 2010 , RTL indicated that the name Telekids would be used

events.text: Telekids returned to television every morning on RTL 8.

evidence.quote: Since 18 October 2010 , RTL Telekids can be seen every morning on RTL 8
start of Telekids was postponed for two weeks until October 18 , 2010

events.text: Telekids broadcast longer and added afternoon airings.

evidence.quote: Since September 26 , 2011 , Telekids has been running longer

events.text: Telekids launched its own digital channel, RTL Telekids.

evidence.quote: On September 3 , 2012 , Telekids started its own digital channel
Since September 3 , 2013 , there is also a digital channel called Telekids 24/7

undated_mentions: Early years: Irene Moors initially the only presenter, daily broadcast
First season: moved from Luxembourg broadcast to large studio in Hilversum
First season: Czech movie The Firemens Ball broadcast by accident
Gold record (65,000 copies) for the 1992 CD Irene Moors en de Telekids; date not stated
